reapack.name: JS_Build layer variations.lua
reapack.desc: Build aligned layer variations (gunshots, impacts, etc.)

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New ReaImGui window replaces the old text-box prompt. Window shows the selected layers and how many files each has, and updates live as you change the selection. Transient threshold is now adjustable in the window. Window stays open after Build so you can tweak and build again. Requires ReaImGui (Extensions > ReaPack > Browse packages > ReaImGui).
